name: ppt-minimal-skill-v6
description: v6 of the teaching-deck builder: the exact v5 house style plus arrow-chain slides. Each content slide is chosen as either a source slide (bullets close to the source wording) or a chain slide (Concept -> mechanism -> meaning, or Effect <- cause, with the middle segment kept from the source sentence). Arrow direction is decided per bullet by a read-aloud test, every segment gets its own color and the formats alternate per bullet, and qa.py checks the chains. Use when asked for 'v6' or arrow-style slides. Skills: `ppt-minimal-skill-v6`.
